newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine limits 1997 precious metal exports.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine limits 1997 precious metal exports.

text.p: Ukraine's government is introducing quotas this year on its already small exports of precious metals, Interfax-Ukraine news agency reported on Monday.

Citing a recent government decision, it said exports of precious metals and amalgams were limited to 135 kg, raw and finished diamonds to 100,000 carats, and precious and semi-precious stones to 10 tonnes.
Platinum exports were set at 300 kg.
A limit of 1.35 tonnes was set for raw, semi-complete and powdered silver.

Ninety kg of raw, semi-complete and powdered gold, including gold covered with galvanized platinum, could be exported this year. Exports of scrap from precious-metal coated metals was limited to five tonnes and precious metal coins to 224 kg.
No figures were available for exports in previous years.
